info.name: SpotDraft V1 Contract APIs V2 Users API

items.docs: Returns the Roles that exist for the workspace whose credentials are used.

params.name: role_id
params.description: Use the [Get Active Roles](#tag/v21-users/GET/api/v2.1/public/auth/roles/) API to get the role ID.

items.docs:
Adds one or more users to the specified role within the current workspace.
Use this when role membership is managed separately from user creation.

params.name: role_id
params.description: Use the [Get Active Roles](#tag/v21-users/GET/api/v2.1/public/auth/roles/) API to get the role ID.

items.docs:
Removes one or more users from the specified role within the current workspace.
The role itself is not deleted.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of items to return per page.

params.name: page
params.description: The page to return. Page numbers start at 1.

params.name: user_email
params.description: User email address for which that user list should be filtered. Please make sure that the value is url encoded. So for example, if the email address is `abc+123@xyz.com` the value passed should be `abc%2B123%40xyz.com`.

items.docs:
Lists users in the organization backing the current workspace.
Use `page`, `limit`, and `user_email` to page through results or narrow the list.
